name: handwriting-pull
title: Handwriting from the cloud
description: Copies new handwritten pages from a cloud folder (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Nextcloud...) with rclone into Handwritten notes' folder every 2 hours, skipping metered connections; never deletes anything.

commands.name: hwpull
commands.what: when it last pulled; /hwpull now pulls now

programs.name: rclone
programs.what: copies the pages from your cloud with its own sign-in

programs.name: nmcli
programs.what: asks NetworkManager whether the connection is metered
